name: CE_CP_STMT_HEADERS_INT
description: This interface table contains the bank statement header.

columns.name: CP_STMT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Sequentially generated surrogate key for the statement headers interface table.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
